id_convention: 9-digit new_id (filename stem); train/val/smoke_* refer to TrainingSet/, test refers to TestingSet/ (official test split untouched)
grouping_method: source-document groups = connected components over (forged<->paired authentic edges, pHash-256 hamming<=20) ∪ (pHash-256 near-duplicate edges, hamming<=20) over all forged+authentic images of both splits; val sampled by whole groups (seed=42, target 15% of train); groups touching the test split are kept in train and flagged

notes.smoke_selection: stratified by tamper-area bin (<1%,1-5%,5-20%,>20%) proportional to the parent subset; within bin round-robin over (source_dataset, assigned_tool) cells
